Hi Sven —

Following up with the technical specifics we discussed. Short answers first, then recommended next steps.

Region availability / deployment mode:
- Hosted API: We have EU-hosted endpoints (Frankfurt and Dublin) and can enforce EU-only routing for production traffic. That means no egress to non-EU regions for requests and model execution.
- Dedicated: Reserved GPU pools can be provisioned in eu-west-1 (Dublin) or eu-central-1 (Frankfurt) depending on your preferred cloud. Dedicated gives you predictable throughput and isolation but requires a 30–60 day provisioning window for larger pool sizes.
- Private VPC / On-prem: We provide a customer-managed control plane option for VPC peering in your AWS account (or on-prem deployment) so all traffic and keys stay under your network controls. This is our strongest option for organizations that need strict network controls and auditability.

Cross-region routing / DR:
- By default our smart routing can route to nearest healthy region for latency. For NordBank we can disable cross-region failover for production to meet EU-only requirements and enable cross-region replication for backups only (encrypted at rest with customer KMS).

Latency notes:
- With eu-central-1 (Frankfurt) hosting and our optimized runtime, 95th percentile token latency for short prompts is typically <100ms inside the same region. Cross-AZ network hops add minimal jitter.

Recommendations:
1) If procurement timeline is short and you want fastest time-to-value: Hosted EU-only endpoints (Frankfurt) + EU-only routing enforced.
2) If you need guaranteed isolation and predictable SLA: Dedicated capacity in eu-central-1. We'll size based on your QPS and sequence length (please share sample traffic).
3) If you require full network control and audit footprint under your VPC: Private VPC (on-prem possible) — this has longer lead time and an enterprise license.

Attachments: region-availability-matrix.xlsx (matrix of region options, lead times, and minimum commit sizes).

Next steps:
- Marissa/Aditya to run a short tech call (30 min) with Katrin and your procurement/security to confirm the right path.
- Sven: if you can share expected QPS and sample prompt lengths, we’ll prepare a Dedicated sizing estimate.
- We’ll also provide a SOC2 evidence pack and our standard SLAs for the options.

Happy to join Thur morning CET — I’ll be available 08:30–11:00 CET.

Thanks,
